notes: name_en is the CLDR English display name (alt-less form) and is informational only.
subregion/continent come from CLDR territoryContainment (UN M49 based); groupings (EU, EZ, UN, 003, 202, 419) and deprecated groups are ignored.
QO (Outlying Oceania) is CLDR's container for AC, AQ, CP, DG and TA; it is kept verbatim and treated as unclassified for regional-continuity scoring.
